==Game Abilities==

===Basic Abilities ===
*Crit Rate Buff
*Power Burn
'''Teleport Charges'''

* Gain a Teleport Charge every 12 seconds (Max Stacks: 3)
*When Skywarp is hit by a Critical Hit, 25% chance to remove a Teleport Charge. Scout bots have a 50% chance instead.
*If Skywarp Dodges a hit from a Special Attack, Skywarp gains a Teleport Charge. Limit 1 Teleport Charge per Special Attack.

'''Critical Ranged Attack'''

* Ranged Attack have a 20% chance to cause 10% Special Attack Down for 5 seconds.
*Heavy Ranged Attack have a 50% chance to cause 10% Special Attack Down for 9 seconds.

'''Teleport Attacks'''

*Teleport Attacks have +10~27% Critical Chance.
*Teleport Attacks are Unblockable.
*Teleport Attacks have a 50% Chance to cause Power Lock for 8 seconds.
*Teleports have a 100% chance to Purify Burn Debuffs.

===Special Attacks===

#*Power Steals for 25~50% target’s Max Power.
#*If the opponent reaches 0 Power as a result of this Power Burn, gain a 15% Power Rate Buff for the remainder of the fight (Max stacks: 1)

===Synergy Bonuses===
*[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|frameless]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] Starscream’s Seekers - [[Starscream]], [[Thundercracker]], [[Ramjet]], [[Dirge]] - +5~8~15% Damage and 20~30~75% Armor Piercing for all Decepticon Ranged Attacks.
*[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] Tricky Tech - [[Mirage]] - +3~10~12% Special Attack Damage.
*[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|frameless]] Brain Gain - [[Shockwave]] - 10~15~25% increase to Attack Rating against Demolition Bots. Shockwave only benefits from this bonus if all Bots on the team have this Synergy
*'''[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]]''' Brain Drain - Shockwave - 5~10~25% Ranged evade for 20 seconds at the start of combat.
*'''[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]]''' Leadership (5-Star) - Acting as a beacon of leadership, all lower tier teammates gain +10% Power Rate.

==Strategy==

=== Commander===
Skywarp has vera unique trait of having two modes of special attacks for his first two specials.  Without any Teleport Charges he uses the standard Starscream/Thundercracker special attacks but with Charges he has unique melee attacks. The Teleport Special Attacks are most useful for Power Locking 50/50 and other tertiary benefits. Special 1 is useful for draining Power on successful blasts. Confusingly, his Power Burn Buff appears as a red Power Rate Down on his HUD. Special 2 gives a good crit-damage-reduction Shield buff. Special 3 is for stealing Power and even gains a permanent buff!

Charges are also a great failsafe in the chances you get tagged by enemy Special Attacks, and in case he doesn't a Special Attack Debuff mitigates some damage.

===Opponent===
Skywarp is relatively easy to fight and dodge. Keep in mind as enemies gain slightly more Power than you he's likely to use a ranged Special 1 at the beginnings of a fight before He gets a Charge.  It is annoying when he automatically teleports away from your hard-hitting Specials, so try to bait out Teleport Attacks and use high crit rate bots to remove Charges.

===Strong Match-ups===

====Bots====
*Skywarp is a nightmare to most [[Demolitions]] bots, with his ability to reduce Special Attack Damage and drain Power. His Signature Ability will be particularly annoying for Demo bot who deal big damage on the last hit of their Special Attacks.
*[[Thundercracker]] - Thundercracker will find his brother-in-arms to be his worst nightmare as he can't land Critical Hits. However, don't get hit by Melee Attacks.

====Mods====
*Mod Name - sentence.

=== Weak Match-ups ===

==== Bots====
*Skywarp has a chance to lose Teleport charges when he is hit by Critical Hits, especially against [[Scout|Scouts]]. They can also block or drain Power, preventing Skywarp from using his Teleport attacks.
*[[Hot Rod]] - Hot Rod will find Skywarp's Signature Ability to be a minor nuisance.

====Mods====
*Mod Name - sentence.

===Recommended Modules===
Pair these mods with {{PAGENAME}} on your base!
*Mod Name - sentence.
